B: Transmission the barrier may allow, the fraction of the unshielded dose that may pass
B_leak: Transmission a secondary wall may allow for the head leakage
B_pri: Transmission the primary barrier may allow
D_0: Weekly dose at the point beyond the wall with no wall
H: Weekly neutron dose equivalent beyond the proton room wall
H_0: Neutron dose equivalent at 1 m per proton with no wall
P: Design goal for the area beyond the wall
0.02 for the public, 0.1 for radiation workers
T: Occupancy factor of the area beyond the wall
U: Use factor, the fraction of the beam time aimed at that wall
W: Workload, the weekly dose at isocenter, 1 m from the target
W_L: Leakage workload, W counted three times for the IMRT treatments
alpha: Archer fit parameter, the attenuation coefficient deep in the wall
d: Distance from the linac target to the point 0.3 m beyond the wall
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
f: Fraction of the treatments given as IMRT
kappa: Scatter air kerma at 1 m per unit DLP of one scan
lambda: Attenuation length of the neutrons in concrete
n: Number of tenth value layers, log₁₀(1/B)
r: Distance from the patient to the point beyond the wall
